OK!
Tomorrow will be a home run!{be01}

Stu: We lost! Time to walk off...{be01}
Art: Farewell! You won...

Your Pokémon certainly have
what it takes!

You only have one Pokémon ready for
battle? It's more fun with more friends!

Baseball and Pokémon battles
are dramas that don't need scripts!{be01}

To be a great baseball player, you have
to be able to hit, play defense, and run!
